findings.description: The journey model makes consumer optional, but the objective requires declaring the intended consumer family for consumer-facing outcomes. If omission remains valid, typing and consumer-surface validation can be bypassed before close-time enforcement ever sees stable vocabulary.

The seeded evidence rule depends on fixture_only, but the plan only says fixture_only is optional and does not pin its default. Missing fixture_only semantics can make seeded_masks_readiness nondeterministic for older or partially-authored journeys.

The typing function is specified for one surface_class, but journeys can declare multiple surfaces and consumer=both. The plan does not pin journey-level aggregation semantics that require at least one human-surface requirement and at least one agent-surface requirement to be satisfied together.

The structured_error rule depends on a degraded or error-path claim, but claim_kind is otherwise closed to read_only, mutation, and qualitative. There is no pinned input field that tells the pure typing rule when an error path is being evaluated.

The mutation requirement notation is ambiguous: the prose says idempotency plus rollback are both required, but the requirement-expression example could be read as alternatives or as malformed grouping.

F004 says degraded_dishonest only when neither family provides availability=unavailable for a required data_source, but the user journey requires both human and agent families to degrade honestly. One family could silently omit its degraded signal while the other family masks the failure.

The checker needs to compare human and agent EvidenceRefs by data_source, but EvidenceRef does not gain an explicit surface_class, consumer_family, or source-family attribution field. Inferring family from evidence_class is underspecified and breaks for shared classes such as structured_error.

F004 adds allowed_degraded_modes to the contract but never specifies how the checker validates or consumes those modes. That leaves an accepted schema field with no behavioral effect in the honesty gate.

The CLI transcript adapter is required to be non-interactive and no live paid call may be made, but the plan does not pin the command contract, fixture mode, or environment guard that prevents accidental paid external execution.

The contract names the typed-skip reason-location fix as D028, while F003 labels the same acceptance point as D029. This drift can cause implementers to miss the exact round-3 typing fix the objective says is in scope.

F002 references a close gate named F005 even though close-time enforcement is explicitly out of scope and delegated to sibling plan 2b. This creates an implementation target that is not part of the objective contract.
